_doc: Per-market configuration. PSX is the desk's home market and its behaviour is unchanged by this file existing — every symbol in state/universe.json without a `market` field is treated as PSX, so nothing that predates markets.json changes shape. See docs/PUBLICATION_RESTRUCTURE.md section 7.
_why_us: Positioning, not coverage. The desk's edge on PSX is structural — scripts/fetch_indices.py exists because no public source carries PSX index history. None of that transfers: on a US single stock the desk would be the ten-thousandth chart. What DOES transfer is the astro lens scored against indices and the Desk Room format. So US coverage is deliberately an index-and-sector layer, not a stock universe.
_why_cheap: scripts/fetch_deep_history.py already fetches query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{symbol}.KA — the .KA is the Karachi suffix. For a US ticker you drop four characters. No API key, no vendor, no bill, and scripts/fetch_global.py has used the same endpoint every cycle for months.

PSX.label: Pakistan Stock Exchange
PSX._source_note: DPS is authoritative for PSX prices (CLAUDE.md: all prices come from the data layer). Yahoo is used only for the deep history and dividends, both cross-checked.

US.label: United States
US._source_note: Yahoo is the only source here and the desk says so. There is no second feed to cross-check against, unlike PSX where DPS and Yahoo corroborate each other — so a US number carries slightly weaker provenance and must not be presented as though it did not.
US._intraday_note: DELIBERATELY OFF. scripts/fetch_intraday.py runs on the PKT 30-minute cycle, and US regular hours are 18:30-01:00 PKT — outside every cycle the desk runs. EOD-only is cheaper AND more publication-shaped: a scheduled daily read is exactly the frame the restructure is building toward.

liquidity._note: USD-denominated, so the PKR floors are meaningless here. These are set so an S&P sector ETF clears comfortably and nothing thin sneaks into the research tier. ADTV in USD.

US._signal_note: US names are RESEARCH-tier only for now. The desk does not signal on them: CLAUDE.md Rule 4's sizing, sector limits and circuit breaker are calibrated on PSX behaviour, and the owner trades PSX. Coverage first, signals never until that is a deliberate separate decision.

symbols._note: ~25 by design. Broad tape, the eleven SPDR sectors, global/EM context, and rates/commodity. No single stocks — see _why_us.
symbols._symbol_note: Index keys are the DESK's symbol, not Yahoo's. A symbol becomes a filename (state/history/{SYM}.json) and then a URL path the browser fetches, and `^` is unsafe in a URL — so `^GSPC` is stored as US500 with the Yahoo spelling in `yahoo`. Never let a vendor's punctuation become a filename.
